The esbuild error is because `@objectstack/service-ai` is imported in `server/index.ts` but was never added to the studio `package.json` dependencies — so turbo doesn't build it and esbuild can't resolve it. Fixed in `78bc887` by adding `"@objectstack/service-ai": "workspace:*"` to `apps/studio/package.json`.


> @copilot 还是报错？ The pattern "api/index.js" defined in `functions` doesn't match any Serverless Functions inside the `api` directory.
> 

The `functions` block referencing `api/index.js` was already removed in `1d49bfd`. The latest build failure (`Could not resolve "@objectstack/service-ai"`) was a separate issue — missing workspace dependency in `package.json`. Fixed in `78bc887`.
